subject.title: fix(subagent): recover terminal transcript before lost context

question: Should OpenClaw accept successful current-run private transcript turns as the recovery boundary for stale subagent lost-context sweeps?
rationale: The code change intentionally changes lifecycle and parent delivery semantics from error to success for a stale active run, and only maintainers can accept that predicate and its upgrade risk.

options.title: Proceed With Private Transcript Boundary
options.body: After rebase and exact-head validation, land or adapt this PR because it follows the current-run private transcript/status boundary established in related maintainer discussion.

options.title: Require Live Gateway Race Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted live Agent Teams or Gateway run that loses context mid-run before accepting the lifecycle recovery behavior.

options.title: Pause Until Rebased
options.body: Keep the draft paused until the contributor or maintainer refreshes the dirty branch and reruns focused validation on the current base.

recommendation.title: Proceed With Private Transcript Boundary
recommendation.body: After rebase and exact-head validation, land or adapt this PR because it follows the current-run private transcript/status boundary established in related maintainer discussion.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the clearest maintainer signal on the private transcript/status boundary in the related PR discussion.
